summary_1line: Manikya Vachaka is saved by Siva through miraculous horses and a flood, while the narrative then shifts to the birth and rise of the devotee Basava.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lord Siva’s ghostly attendants ride into Madura on dazzling horses as dust rises over the city and the imprisoned minister watches in awe.
The magnificent horses in the royal stables transform overnight into howling jackals that scatter through the dark streets of Madura.
Floodwaters from the Vegavati river surge toward Madura while the king realizes his mistake and the shackled Manikya prays to Siva.
